khaitan_ch10.label: Khaitan class, camera 10 (11.5 min, ~28 people, one teacher)
khaitan_ch10.note: Per-frame teacher ground truth in eval/gt/khaitan_ch10.teacher.json, built by eval/annotate_teacher.py from a cue the pipeline may not use (she is the only person not in a coloured school polo) and spot-checked on a 32-crop contact sheet. BASELINE BEFORE THIS WORK: the pipeline labelled NO teacher at all on this lesson - her timeline landed in three different merged identities which then cancelled each other's margin, so every KPI was zero. Gates are identity gates: KPI totals can be right for the wrong reasons.

report_only.note: coverage/purity measured 89.9%/98.9% at the time of writing

demo_teacher.label: Demo lesson (4:46, ~30 pupils, teacher in a dark kurta) - the SECOND room, held out from tuning
demo_teacher.note: Per-frame ground truth from eval/annotate_teacher.py with the DARK cue (this teacher wears a dark patterned kurta among bright polos; the other room's teacher wears white, hence two cues). This fixture exists to catch tuning that only works on one room, and it does its job: every threshold in teacher_track was swept against the Khaitan lesson, the first run here claimed two pupils, and that is what exposed the tracklet over-splitting bug and the degenerate-ground-plane bug. Gates are set at the MEASURED level (59.9% coverage / 80.6% purity), not at an aspiration, so they catch regressions rather than failing permanently. This room is genuinely harder than Khaitan: the uniform-outlier colour signal is worth nothing when the teacher wears dark clothing, and the perspective model cannot be fitted because almost nobody in this lesson stands. Closing that gap needs a real re-ID encoder - see docs/teacher-identification-research.md.
